en: A multi‑view color postcard with four photographs and Swedish text. The upper left shows a scenic rural landscape with forested hills and a lake. The upper right shows a small white wooden church with a steeple surrounded by a graveyard. The lower left shows a rocky shoreline with water and carved figures on the rock surface. The lower right is a close‑up of these rock carvings (petroglyphs). Across the middle is a large greeting text in Swedish, and smaller Swedish captions label the views, including the lake, the church, and the rock carvings.
